About us

Real wok fire, long after midnight

Dragon Wok Master E-11 is a Chinese restaurant in E-11/2, Islamabad, built around one simple idea: great Chinese food, cooked fresh over a roaring wok — and available when you actually crave it.

We stay open every day from 1:00 PM until 4:00 AM, so whether it's a family lunch, a late dinner, or a 2 AM noodle craving, the kitchen is on.

  • Chinese dishes tossed fresh in the wok, to order
  • Open daily until 4:00 AM — a true late-night kitchen
  • Order ahead by phone or WhatsApp
